description: This file defines a custom Document component for a Next.js project, ensuring the '_document' page exists to satisfy Next.js build requirements. It primarily extends the default Document class and customizes the HTML structure.

classes.name: MyDocument
classes.description: A custom class extending Next.js's Document to define the HTML structure of the application.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the JSX layout for the custom HTML document, including language attribute, head, body, main content, and scripts.
